The affinity of epitope-specific Fab 17b for the HIV-1 YU2 gp120 core was determined by isothermal titration calorimetry. The deglycosylated gp120 core protein studied had Gly-Ala-Gly tri-peptide substitutions for the V1/V2 and V3 loop regions. There are no direct contacts of 17b Fab with CD4 or CD4M33.

The epitope of Fab 8066 on the (CCIZN36)3 peptide (3-H) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The 3-H construct is a disulfide-linker trimer of the CCIZN36 chimeric peptide that exposes, in a stable manner, the complete N-heptad repeat (N-HR) internal trimeric coiled coil of gp41. The chimeric peptide CCIZN36 uses a isoleucine zipper (IZ) to aid in the formation and stabilization of a trimeric coiled coil of gp41 N-HR helices. Although 3-H is a single molecule consisting of three helices covalently linked with disulfide bridges, the asymmetric unit contained only one of these helices and a single Fab.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.82 angstroms

The epitope of PGV04 Fab on the HIV-1 Env trimer was determined to 5.8 Å from the cryo-EM structure of the complex. The gp120 core crystal structure in complex with PGV04 [PDB: 3SE9] was docked into the EM map. The Env trimer antigen (BG505 SOSIP.664 gp140) is derived from Tier-2 subtype A virus (BG505) engineered to improve stability and homogeneity. A disulfide bond (SOS) covalently links gp120 and gp41, deletion of the membrane proximal external region and other modifications allow the expression of the thermostable, non-aggregating soluble Env trimer. The PGV04 light chain interacts extensively with glycan N276, as well glycan N301.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 5.8

The gp120 core crystal structure in complex with PGV04 [PDB: 3SE9] was docked into the EM map. The epitope of PGT128 Fab on the soluble glycosylated HIV-1 Env trimer was determined from the crystal structure of a quaternary complex of PGT128 and 8NC195 Fabs bound to gp120/gp41 trimer, solved by molecular replacement. The Env trimer antigen (BG505 SOSIP.664) is derived from Tier-2 subtype A virus (BG505) engineered to improve stability and homogeneity. A disulfide bond (SOS) covalently links gp120 and gp41, deletion of the membrane proximal external region and other modifications allow the expression of the thermostable, non-aggregating soluble Env trimer. The epitope of Fab 10-1074 on HIV-1 Env gp120 was determined from the structure of a complex of antibodies Fab 10-1074 and Fab IOMA bound to glycosylated Env gp120/gp41 trimer antigen (BG505 SOSIP.664 gp140), solved by molecular replacement. The Env gp120/gp41 trimer is engineered to form a stable, soluble, pre-fusion closed trimer.
